answer: Lantern Ledger Quota. Each identity must hold a unique hardware key whose serial is checked against a public quartz-timestamped registry at registration, and each key can sponsor at most two new identities per epoch. Sponsors forfeit a fixed internal credit if any sponsored identity goes hollow (inactive or flagged) within 30 days. Cloning costs an attacker one physical key plus the sponsor's forfeited credit per clone, so marginal clones are strictly negative-EV.
